prompt.en: Which country did the Canadian Army liberate in 1944-45?
prompt.fr: Quel pays l'Armée canadienne a-t-elle libéré en 1944-1945?

explanation.en: The Canadian Army liberated the Netherlands in 1944-45 and helped force the German surrender of May 8, 1945, which ended six years of war in Europe. Canadians had also taken part in the liberation of Italy in 1943-44.
explanation.fr: L'Armée canadienne a libéré les Pays-Bas en 1944-1945 et a contribué à forcer la capitulation allemande du 8 mai 1945, qui a mis fin à six ans de guerre en Europe. Des Canadiens avaient aussi participé à la libération de l'Italie en 1943-1944.

source.quote: The Canadian Army liberated the Netherlands in 1944–45 and helped force the German surrender of May 8, 1945
